name: EPIC 201373302
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 10, 10.8 solar radii and 1.04 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,225 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.04 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,972 K at its surface.
